close_reason: Added RFC 8620 §5.5 compliance note: total is returned as the cap (honest lower bound) when capped, not omitted — so calculateTotal=true is honored correctly.
description: email.rs lines 631-636: when the result set is capped at COLLAPSE_THREADS_MAX_EMAILS, total is set to None. The comment says 'Total is only honest when the fetch was not capped' but does not explain the client-visible consequence: if the client sent calculateTotal=true it will receive a response with no 'total' field at all (silent omission, not an error). This is surprising and likely spec-non-conformant — RFC 8620 §5.5 says total MUST be present when calculateTotal=true. The comment should either explain why omission is acceptable here, or flag this as a known gap.
title: collapseThreads cap silently omits total from response
